title: GOD TNT SULFUR CUBE
description: Adds An Infinite Tnt Sulfur Cube Grenade
body:
THIS ADDS CRAZY TNT SULFUR CUBES TO MINECRAFT THAT ACT AS INFINITE GRENADES

This is a really crazy mod with an expensive crafting recipe, and it adds a bucket of Tnt Sulfur Cubes that auto refills and explodes after 20 Game Ticks
